label: BCR::ABL1

sections.text: BCR encodes a signaling protein with oligomerization and Rho-family GTPase-regulatory domains.
ABL1 encodes a nonreceptor tyrosine kinase that regulates cell growth, adhesion and DNA-damage responses.

The Philadelphia-chromosome rearrangement joins the BCR oligomerization region to the ABL1 kinase, generating constitutive tyrosine-kinase signaling. It defines CML and a major B-ALL subtype; p210 and p190 are common transcript products.
ABL1-directed tyrosine-kinase inhibitors are established treatment components in CML and Philadelphia-positive ALL. Fusion transcript quantification also provides a molecular response marker.
